notes.title: Demo Update for Frog's Galaxy Escape!
notes.content:
We’re excited to release the latest update for the Frog's Galaxy Escape demo! Here are the changes:

[list]
New Menu: The main menu has been revamped for a more intuitive and user-friendly experience. 
[/list]
[list]
Improved Colors: All in-game colors have been enhanced, making the visual experience more pleasant and immersive.
[/list]
[list]
First Level Adjustments: The last two stages of the first level have been removed as they were too lengthy for a tutorial, providing a smoother introduction to the game.
[/list]

We’re still hard at work improving the demo, and while there’s more to polish, this update marks an important step toward a better and more enjoyable gameplay experience. We look forward to your feedback!
